Messages.Author: wastaz
Messages.Body:
If I breed via for example the embrace from a scarce vampire (say, a true brujah) - does the new vampire become scarce as well (forcing me to pay the scarce penalty)?

If I have bred some vampires from a scarce clan (sau true brujah), when I later influence out a new "real" true brujah vampire, do I need to pay the scarce penalty for all my mini-vampires as well, or only for my "real" true brujahs?

Messages.Author: Pagan
Messages.Body:
> Scarce: When a Methuselah moves a scarce vampire from her uncontrolled region to her ready region during her influence phase, she must burn 3 pool for every other vampire of the same clan already in play.
>

Messages.Author: wastaz
Messages.Body:
> Pagan wrote:
>
> > Scarce: When a Methuselah moves a scarce vampire from her uncontrolled region to her ready region during her influence phase, she must burn 3 pool for every other vampire of the same clan already in play.
> >
That should answer question number 2, but question one still remains

Messages.Author: Pagan
Messages.Body: No clan is Scarce by default, just some happen to all be scarce. The Embraces(or other) baby vamps will not be scarce, but as above they are counted when influencing up a scarce vampire of that clan.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Pagan wrote:
> No clan is Scarce by default, just some happen to all be scarce. The Embraces(or other) baby vamps will not be scarce, but as above they are counted when influencing up a scarce vampire of that clan.
>
Correct.
Unless cardtext says so, a vampire isn't Scarce.
